:::{#thm-ci-prob}

#### Confidence interval for a predicted probability

In a [logistic regression model](#def-logistic-regression),
let $(L, R)$ be a 95% [confidence interval](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/inference.html#def-confidence-interval) for the log-odds $\logodds(\vx) = \dprodf{\vx}{\vb}$.
Then:

$$\pi(\vx) \in \paren{\expit(L), \expit(R)}$$

is a 95% confidence interval for the predicted probability $\pi(\vx) = \Pr(Y = 1 | \vX = \vx)$.

:::

::: proof

This proof is the solution to @exr-ci-prob.

:::
